yaml.title: About
yaml.description: Senior data scientist and R/Shiny engineer with a PhD in Finance.

markdown.markdown:
Hi, I'm Wlademir Ribeiro Prates. I'm a senior data scientist and R/Shiny engineer. Today I lead an R/Shiny development and QA team at Halo Media, building analytical applications for Marsh. Before that I spent close to a decade turning data into products and decisions, first as a consultant in Brazil and then as an engineer for companies in the United States and Europe. I hold a PhD and a Master's in Finance from UFSC, where I researched behavioral finance and capital markets. This site is where I collect what I learn: applied analyses with code, notes on taking data applications to production, and reflections on building a career in data. ::: {.edu} ::: {.edu-item} PhD in Finance Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (UFSC) · 2012–2016 ::: ::: {.edu-item} Master's in Finance Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (UFSC) · 2010–2012 ::: ::: {.edu-item} Bachelor's in Business Administration Anhanguera · 2006–2009 ::: ::: ## Experience ::: {.timeline} ::: {.timeline-item .current} 2025 – present · New York, remote

Technical Team Lead · Halo Media

Joined as Senior R/Shiny Engineer and now lead the development and QA team that builds analytical tools and dashboards for Marsh. Architecture decisions, code review, automated testing and CI/CD, and mentoring developers. ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2024 – 2025 · Los Angeles, remote

Senior Data Scientist, R/Shiny Developer · Firebird

Analytical web applications for the music industry, helping bands plan and optimize tours. Shiny on top of BigQuery, with rhino, R6 and telemetry. ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2021 – 2024 · Warsaw, remote

Senior R/Shiny Developer, then Tech Lead · Appsilon

Shiny applications for Genmab, comparing patient treatments with statistical tests and rich visualizations. Also apps for Warner Bros., from budget planning to an internal GPT tool for film concepts. ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2020 – 2021 · São Paulo, remote

Data Science Specialist · Tembici

Led analyses with statistical modeling and machine learning, and built and maintained the customer churn model in production. The same kind of work behind [this article](posts/predictive-customer-churn-analysis/index.qmd). ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2018 – 2020 · São Paulo

Senior Data Scientist, then Data Science Manager · EY

People Analytics consulting for companies such as Vivo (Telefónica), BASF and Braskem: predicting employee turnover, understanding what drives productivity, and in-company training on hypothesis testing, visualization and machine learning. ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2017 – 2018 · Florianópolis

Data Scientist · Aquarela Advanced Analytics

Predictive and prescriptive projects with dashboards in R/Shiny for Votorantim, Embraer and DHL, from predictive maintenance for aircraft parts to the best delivery time in logistics. ::: ::: {.timeline-item} 2015 – 2017 · Florianópolis

Earlier

Knowledge management in personal and corporate finance at Par Mais, and a year as professor at UFSC's Department of Production Engineering. ::: ::: ## Teaching Teaching has run alongside the industry work the whole time. Since 2024 I teach online data science classes and mentor people starting in the field at Data Mundo. From 2019 to 2021 I taught the machine learning and NLP modules of an MBA in artificial intelligence and big data at Sustentare Escola de Negócios, and in 2015 I was a professor at UFSC. ## What I work with - **R and Shiny**, from exploratory analysis to applications used in production, with testing, CI/CD and telemetry around them. - **Machine learning applied to business problems**, with attention to whether the model actually changes a decision. - **SQL and cloud data warehouses** such as BigQuery and Redshift, plus Python and LLM tooling when the problem asks for it. - **Reproducible reporting** with Quarto and R Markdown. - **Finance and behavioral economics** as the analytical background behind much of my work. ## Book I wrote [O Manual do Cientista de Dados](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/), a free and open handbook in Portuguese about data science in practice: statistics, modeling, visualization and the reasoning behind them. It is an ongoing project, with source and contributions on [GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados). ## Research Before moving to industry, I did academic research in behavioral finance and capital markets at UFSC, mostly on the disposition effect and how investors decide under risk. Selected papers: - Dorow, A., da Costa, N., Takase, E., **Prates, W. R.** & Da Silva, S. (2018). [On the neural substrates of the disposition effect and return performance](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbef.2017.12.003). *Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Finance*. - **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N. & Dorow, A. (2017). [Risk aversion, the disposition effect, and group decision making: an experimental analysis](https://doi.org/10.1002/mde.2843). *Managerial and Decision Economics*. - **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N., Armada, M. J. R. & Da Silva, S. (2019). [Propensity to sell stocks in an artificial stock market](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0215685). *PLoS ONE*. - **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N. & Santos, A. P. (2019). [Efeito disposição: propensão à venda de investidores individuais e institucionais](https://doi.org/10.5935/0034-7140.20190005). *Revista Brasileira de Economia*. The full list is on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=pt-BR&user=DIaC850AAAAJ). ## Get in touch The best place to reach me is [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wlademir-ribeiro-prates/). For shorter, more informal content, I'm on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/datamundo.cientista/) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@wlademir).
